entries.title_en: Home care for cough and cold
steps_en: Keep breastfeeding, and keep feeding the child during the illness.
Give home fluids, as much as the child will take. This helps the cough.
If the baby is under 6 months and takes only breast milk, do not give any home remedy.
If the child is over 6 months, you can give a safe home remedy such as honey, tulsi or ginger. Do not give cough syrups.
Keep the nose clean with a soft cotton cloth, and use salt-water nose drops: ½ teaspoon of salt in 1 glass (250 ml) of clean drinking water. Make it fresh every day.
steps_hi: स्तनपान जारी रखिए, और बीमारी में भी बच्चे को खाना खिलाते रहिए।

अगर बच्चा 6 महीने से बड़ा है, तो शहद, तुलसी या अदरक जैसा सुरक्षित घरेलू नुस्खा दे सकते हैं। खांसी का सिरप मत दीजिए।

entries.title_en: Extra fluid and food for diarrhoea

steps_en: Give extra fluid, as much as the child will take, until the diarrhoea stops.
If the child takes only breast milk: breastfeed often, and for longer at each feed. If the stools are frequent and watery, give ORS as well as breast milk.
If the child is 6 months or older, also give home fluids: ORS, buttermilk, milk, lemon drink, rice or dal water, vegetable soup, coconut water, or plain clean water.
After each loose stool, on top of the usual drinks, give: ¼ to ½ cup (50–100 ml) if under 2 years; ½ to 1 cup (100–200 ml) if 2 years or older.
Keep feeding the child.
steps_hi: दस्त रुकने तक बच्चे को ज़्यादा पेय दीजिए, जितना वह पी सके।

अगर बच्चा 6 महीने या उससे बड़ा है, तो घर के पेय भी दीजिए: ORS, छाछ, दूध, नींबू पानी, चावल या दाल का पानी, सब्ज़ी का सूप, नारियल पानी, या साफ़ पानी।
